description: Old, local, and still extremely serious. The specific good here is physical rather than cognitive: a body that is working, tired in the correct way, and not being thought about.
The hour after is reliably better than the hour during, and it is the part people actually return for.
Asked years later what made wrestling good, people name the company rather than the content. The Harvard Study of Adult Development has been producing that result for eighty-seven years.
notes: Harvard Study of Adult Development: relationship quality is the strongest single predictor of health and happiness.

description: A place, kit, subscription or other people free at the same time. Safety after dark decides a great deal of this, and decides it differently for women.
notes: Where movement after dark is unsafe, this whole family narrows sharply by gender. See BOD/SEC in assets/text/nigeria.

description: Playing wrestling stops being an event and becomes a reference point - retold, compared against, and eventually shorthand inside one family for a whole kind of day.
energy_note: It turns into the story about it.
notes: Experiential purchases retain value through memory where material ones decay; people are markedly unwilling to trade the memory away.
